sentences.japanese: 嘘ばっかりついてるから、皆に総すかんを食うんだ。自業自得だよ。
sentences.english: You're always lying- that's why people don't take you seriously. You get what you deserve.

sentences.japanese: 意味のある変革がなされるならば、私は政治改革に総じて賛成だ。
sentences.english: In the main, I am in favor of political reform if meaningful changes are made.

sentences.japanese: ちょっと待ってよ、そんなに単純に、終わりよければ総て良し、ってわけにはいかないよ。
sentences.english: Wait a second. Do you just think that all's well that ends well? That's not the way it is.
